hooks.text: 先削弱敌人斗志再用金币把其招募为佣兵
hooks.excerpt: Offer them gold and turn them to your side. Wear down their health to break their fighting spirit, and eventually they’ll have no choice but to accept your offer!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 卡牌、遗物、佣兵与金币利息共同形成远征协同
hooks.excerpt: Combine cards, relics, and mercenaries to create the ultimate synergy. Surviving the battle alone is not enough. Manage your remaining gold wisely to earn more interest, and strengthen your deck and team even further.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 携带佣兵与战利品撤离，但地牢内损失无法追回
hooks.excerpt: Preserve the mercenaries you’ve recruited, along with the cards and relics you’ve collected, and expand your resources even further. This will help you prepare more thoroughly for your next dungeon run. However, anything lost inside the dungeon cannot be recovered. Choose the right moment to escape carefully.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
